summary: Learn to assess customer barriers, improve product suitability and track redress in digital finance. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Digital financial services training for vulnerable populations helps product, customer-protection and channel teams assess barriers and improve customer outcomes. It covers mapping vulnerability across digital journeys, checking fees and product features for suitability, and designing support and complaint processes for failed transactions. Teams also define measures for access, meaningful use and redress, giving them a practical basis for prioritising service changes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate or oversee digital financial services and need to address barriers that affect vulnerable customers.
modules: Digital Journey Support and Failure Points
OECD Principles for Data and Decisions
prerequisites: Working familiarity with digital financial services operations, customer onboarding, payments or customer support is recommended. No coding is required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
